actions.writes: Reviewer-owned out/audit/native-runner-review and bounded temporary source-control fixtures only.

assessed_guards: Native mode is explicit and exclusive; release and recovery selections fail preflight. Build/publication job is skipped, native job contents/actions permissions are read only, existing active runs are not cancelled.

Fixed original run/artifact/source metadata and actual unsplit ISO bytes/SHA/metadata are verified before any VM through pinned unchanged common v2 primitives. Candidate source, ae55 base, actual new execution head and schema-3 runtime manifest remain distinct.

Inherited workflow YAML is equal to ae55 after removing only the new native input/job and three native-routing guards. Frozen v2 files/manifest are unchanged; its old route intentionally cannot qualify the changed workflow.

Native checker source/manifest/independent review remain exact. Adapter replay replaces only main; every other source byte/top-level function/class AST is preserved. Guard or cleanup failure stays failed.
Optional test-only audio uses output-only emulated HDA and file-only WAV with no host sound device, microphone or audio-server forwarding. Capability failure has no backend fallback.

Fresh owned VM and extraction paths prevent overwrite. Transport file/count/byte/chunk/zlib/hash limits fail closed. Required screenshots are transported and hash-matched, never interpreted as a visual pass.

Live and installed boot IDs are canonical and distinct; corresponding cmdline, exact offline/install/probe markers, installed collector boundary, mapped LUKS2 root and all eight native gates are mandatory.

Detached root worker waits at most 30 seconds for exact owned shell/Foot PID-fd readiness and identity disappearance; exclusive same-boot proof and ready/gone order are checked. Unrelated existing native apps continue to fail unchanged setup.

Inherited owned Docker/process-group timeout cleanup is reused without engine ambiguity, global cleanup, host permission changes or service/security/network changes. Failed harness/stage/audio evidence stays visible.

WAV requires finalized 48kHz stereo S16 PCM, matching frames and some nonzero PCM; silence/corruption/truncation fail. Large files yield bounded labeled excerpts, not a claim of player attribution or perceived sound.

controls.real_process_controls: Only newly owned /usr/bin/sleep children, natural exit and retained-process pidfd timeout. No signal, desktop process, Docker, QEMU or VM was started.
controls.real_wav_controls: Local synthetic PCM files exercised silence, nonzero content, truncation, corrupt header, full-copy and bounded-excerpt paths. No host audio forwarding.
controls.resource_warning_policy: ResourceWarning treated as error in final replays
controls.runtime_source_gate_fixture: Actual isolated pinned files/hash checks; git head/cleanliness/ancestry responses stubbed. Real clean execution head is a future CI gate.
controls.serial_controls: Synthetic live/installed serial evidence; malformed paths/chunks/hashes/gates/provenance/root encryption/launcher/screenshot records fail closed, first-stage evidence survives missing second stage.

findings_closed.finding: Draft accepted an all-hyphen 36-character boot ID.
findings_closed.resolution: Canonical lowercase 8-4-4-4-12 hex UUID guard; original reproduction now rejects it and canonical valid records pass.

findings_closed.finding: Preliminary integration retained the harness Foot terminal, conflicting with the unchanged fresh-native-app setup gate. Owner/root identified the conflict; preliminary pin was held and superseded.
findings_closed.resolution: Opt-in bounded detached launcher discovers the actual nearest nonroot shell and /usr/bin/foot ancestor, holds PID-fds and waits for their natural exit without sending signals. Checker requires same-boot root0600 proof, exact pinned helper, vanished PID/start identities, root-probe ancestry, matching desktop UID and active Wayland session. Default live/installed typed commands and default QEMU argv remain equal.

promoted_tree_observation.note: Parent owns promotion. Final frozen payload was independently reconstructed and every runtime hash verified. Preliminary uncommitted worktree must be refreshed and reverified before its new execution commit; this review does not certify a future commit hash.

remaining: Parent refreshes revised frozen payload in its separate qualification branch, verifies schema-3 pins, and supplies the distinct clean execution head before any authorized push/dispatch.
Actual supported-CI metadata/ISO-byte checks and native live/offline encrypted install/first-installed VM execution remain unrun by this review.
Actual Foot/fish/sudo detached launcher, native GUI actions and cleanup must qualify in that VM; host component controls do not prove complete guest integration.
Actual screenshots and emulated WAV require content review. Nonzero PCM alone cannot prove exclusive media-player attribution, audible quality or physical hardware.

Portal/AT-SPI coverage remains read-only reachability; no returned-file chooser, application accessibility tree or screen-reader acceptance is inferred. Pre-existing disabled kernel auditing stays an explicit telemetry limit.

Broad release/media/codecs/mount/accessibility/recovery/Secure Boot/update/Nix/performance gates remain separate. Original Nix failure, historical Kitty regression and both active runs retain their original outcomes.
